issues.problem: Vertical drift accumulates down the list: card 1 text sits ~1px lower (Amazon baseline y~115 vs 114), cards 2 and 3 and their text ~1px lower (Central Africa y~186 vs 185, Indian Ocean y~256 vs 255), and the Add place / Share row ~1px lower (label y~327 vs 326). Diff shows full red outlines around all three cards and a yellow top edge on Share.
issues.fix: Remove the extra 1px in the stack: check card height (should be ~62px) and gap (8px) for a stray 1px border adding to box height; use box-sizing:border-box on the cards or reduce the list gap/padding-top by 1px so card 2 top lands at y=164 and the button row at y=304.

issues.problem: Active card outline reads slightly heavier/darker than the reference; reference border is a thinner dark-green stroke with the lime fill reaching closer to the edge. Card edges fully outlined in the diff.
issues.fix: Set the active card border to 1.5px (not 2px) in the reference's dark green and keep it inside the box (box-sizing:border-box or use an inset box-shadow) so the outer size stays unchanged.

issues.problem: Pill contents are offset ~1-2px horizontally: pause button center x~571 vs 569, next button x~617 vs 616, 'Amazon · 2019' starts ~1px right, while 'Show controls' starts ~1px left (x~788 vs 789) and its chevron ~1px left. Left edge of the pill is ~1px right (x~545 vs 544), so the pill is ~1px narrower.
issues.fix: Widen the pill by 1px to the left (left: 544px / width 353px) and tighten the internal layout: reduce left padding by 1px and add 1px to the gap after the divider so the chevron sits at x~771 and the label at x~789.

issues.problem: Placeholder text 'Search tracks or places' sits ~1px right and ~1px higher than the reference (x~96 vs 95, y~47 vs 48); the search icon is ~1px left (x~300 vs 301).
issues.fix: Set the input padding-left to 15px, nudge the text down 1px (line-height or padding-top +1px), and move the icon 1px right (right padding -1px).

notes: Very close reproduction: every element is present with correct text, icons, colors, map route, pins and vehicles, and the 0.77% pixel diff is below the anti-aliasing baseline. The remaining differences are all sub-2px offsets, the most systematic being a ~1px downward drift through the mixtape card stack and a ~1px horizontal misfit inside the player pill. No missing elements, wrong content or wrong fonts were found; deductions are for the accumulated small offsets and the slightly heavier active-card border.
